title: Make the store hook subscribe per selector
prompt: useStore copies the whole store into local state, so every component re-renders on any change. Rebuild it on useSyncExternalStore so a component re-renders only when its selected slice changes — the mechanism behind zustand's selectors.
acceptanceCriteria: useStore(selector) returns the selected slice of the current store state
Changing a slice re-renders the components that select it
Changing a slice does NOT re-render a component that selects a different slice
The subscription is removed when a component unmounts
